hypothesis: AppClientLayer attaches a global listener to tabiji:recovery_key_updated that unconditionally displays a toast stating '✨ 帳號引繼碼已自其他裝置同步更新' without asserting isUserLoggedIn() or checking the event detail source. Consequently, whenever an unauthenticated visitor opens the root page and ensureValidSession() boots a new session, the visitor is falsely notified that their key was synced from another device.

initSessionLifecycleListener() invokes ensureValidSession() on mount whenever getCachedToken() is null, without checking isUserLoggedIn(). This forces an unauthenticated visitor to fire a POST /api/auth/session call, creating unnecessary orphan user records in Supabase and writing guest tokens to localStorage before onboarding begins.

isUserLoggedIn() evaluates 'hasNicknameAndId || hasModernRecoveryKey'. When a user_recovery_key exists without user_nickname, it evaluates to true instead of requiring user_nickname && (hasLegacyId || hasModernRecoveryKey). This allows half-initialized or orphan sessions to be mistakenly recognized as logged in.
